# Sports Massage Therapy Cymru

Sports Massage Therapy Cymru is a sports massage clinic in Cardiff. Treatment is for injury recovery and prevention.

## What it offers

- Sports massage
- Dry needling
- Dry cupping
- Deep oscillation, alongside deep tissue massage
- Injury recovery and prevention

## Address

33 Groveland Road
Birchgrove
Cardiff
CF14 4QX
United Kingdom

## Hours

Monday to Friday: 08:30 to 21:30
Saturday to Sunday: 08:30 to 18:30

## Prices

Every price includes all treatments.

- 45 minutes sports massage: £45
- 60 minutes sports massage: £55
- 60 minutes deep tissue and deep oscillation: £70
- 90 minutes sports massage: £80
- 90 minutes deep tissue and deep oscillation: £95

Prices checked against https://www.sporttherapycymru.com/prices and https://sportsmassagetherapycymru.setmore.com/book on 3 November 2026.
